sources.deltaFinding: Complete650-line authored delta read. Common runtime trap builds declaration-based diagnostics for Windows/Wasm then terminates; Linux retains its separate existing trap behavior, without whole-platform parity credit. Async expression reads require a valid continuation slot and load resumed values. Bounded readonly references, members and indexed values materialize canonical inline value ABI and reconstruct local handles. Literal arrays/dictionaries use source-owned placement, capacity and element-store helpers. Reserve dispatch covers collection families. Parallel additional arguments and bounded mapped results use committed function ABI.
